fusions.name: Spur Through Plate
fusions.desc: Drives a spur through a joint in the target's plate for 30 damage that ignores its armour, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Breastplate Clang
fusions.desc: Flares your hackles and wings, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 3 tiles and leaving each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mail Over Down
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Feather Upon Feather
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a layer builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield worth 7% of your maximum health per layer. Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 6% at all times.
